method: Independent visual comparison of the full original page images against review/pages/086.json and 094.json; enlarged original column crops and handwritten-name crop. No outside sources used; source review files were not edited.

pages.scope: Every visible entry and line across all four columns, including marked and redacted areas. Covered text was not inferred.

corrections.reason: The final printed surname character is an e in the enlarged original scan.
The printed label is b, with its stem above the bowl, not p.

structural_notes.note: Phones is a handwritten annotation inside the same circled area as Maronet, Bill / ETC / 561-881-8118. Consider attaching it as a source annotation to E1445 rather than presenting it as a separate contact.

uncertainty_notes: Katie B[unclear] and the A.R. Loud[unclear] handwritten annotation remain appropriately uncertain; I could not establish a safer complete reading.
Redaction bars hide multiple lines and partially cross adjacent glyphs. I did not use nearby unredacted entries to reconstruct covered characters.
The RANCH (RH) heading and Mike Pezulo spelling agree with the larger crops.
pages.other_findings: Other recorded readable lines agree with my independent visual reading; this is not a claim of perfect scan legibility.

pages.scope: Entire portrait page, all eight handwritten name/number pairs and the star beside the final row.
